object: functionally gradient multicomponent materials by 3D printing
problem: How to print multicomponent gradient material libraries at high throughput without long cycle times and specialized equipment?
mechanism_or_method: 3D-printed precursor materials with proportioned components, then self-propagating energy deposition to form copper-based gradient composites.
limitation: Demonstrated on copper-based composites only; scalability and property validation beyond demonstrations unclear.
decision_relevance: Offers route to graded-material fabrication for additive manufacturing process selection.

object: nonequilibrium bipartite sensors with nonreciprocal coupling
problem: What are the physical limits on sensing performance when nonreciprocal couplings drive a system out of equilibrium?
mechanism_or_method: Stochastic thermodynamic analysis of linear bipartite systems showing a Maxwell-demon subsystem violates fluctuation-dissipation relation and boosts signal-to-noise ratio.
limitation: Linear model only; no experimental realization of nonreciprocal sensor demonstrated.

object: light-responsive soft actuators in optical feedback loops
problem: How can responsive materials communicate directionally over long range to form self-oscillating networks?
mechanism_or_method: Photomechanical operators of baffle and soft actuator interrupt light beams in closed optical feedback loops, yielding self-oscillation and signal transmission.
limitation: Requires precise optical alignment; bench-scale demonstrations only.

object: refractory medium-entropy alloy with boride phase
problem: How to retain room-temperature plasticity while achieving high strength up to 2073 K in refractory alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Boron interfacial segregation creates gradient-ordering phase boundaries in a (WTaV)90B10 BCC plus boride dual-phase alloy.
limitation: Only ~6% room-temperature plasticity; small lab samples; long-term creep and oxidation not addressed.
decision_relevance: Informs alloy selection for hypersonic structural components at extreme temperatures.

object: quinone redox molecules for aqueous electrochemical CO2 capture
problem: How to make reduced quinones stable toward oxygen while preserving CO2 binding in electrochemical capture?
mechanism_or_method: Tetraalkylammonium ion pairing with naphthoquinone shifts redox potential and promotes CO2 adduct formation, verified by spectrophotometry and voltammetry.
limitation: Lab flow-cell scale; 87% Coulombic efficiency and 157 kJ/mol energy cost remain high.

object: multi-principal element alloy micropillars
problem: Can amorphization be extended to the micrometer scale to replace shear-band failure and improve damage tolerance?
mechanism_or_method: Continuous compression strain-training from low to high strain rates creates a dislocation gradient forming a topological disorder network termed hyper-range amorphization.
limitation: Demonstrated only on micropillars; transfer to bulk components untested.

object: waste-to-resource knowledge graph for industrial symbiosis
problem: How to automatically build a scalable waste-to-resource database from literature for industrial symbiosis identification?
mechanism_or_method: LLM-based pipeline with retrieving, extraction and fusion modules converts research papers into a knowledge graph of waste and resource entities.
limitation: Extraction quality depends on LLM and literature coverage; practical symbiosis outcomes not validated.
decision_relevance: Supports practitioners screening candidate waste exchanges between industries.

object: San Andreas Fault seismicity modulated by tides and hydrology
problem: What do frequency-dependent tidal and hydrological modulations of earthquakes reveal about nucleation and pore fluid diffusion?
mechanism_or_method: Statistical analysis of ordinary and low-frequency earthquake catalogs against tidal and hydrological stress to constrain fault properties and nucleation times.
limitation: Single fault segment; inferred nucleation physics relies on model assumptions about fluid diffusion.

object: sulfur hexafluoride greenhouse gas degradation
problem: Can SF6 be mineralized in one step at ambient temperature without harsh conditions or post-treatment?
mechanism_or_method: UV irradiation of KOH in water/isopropanol with autocatalytic acetone photosensitizer produces sulfite and fluoride salts.
limitation: Lab-scale batch reaction; scalability claim not demonstrated in the abstract.

object: CO2 hydrate formation in mesoporous zeolite ZMQ-1
problem: How does pore confinement in a mesoporous zeolite enable fast, mild-condition CO2 hydrate formation?
mechanism_or_method: CO2 adsorption on pre-humidified ZMQ-1 with FTIR identification of hydrate, comparing calcined and non-calcined zeolite to map spatial distribution.
limitation: Lab-scale adsorption tests; cycling stability and scale-up not shown.

object: electrochemically mediated amine regeneration CO2 release interface
problem: How does the electrolyte anion govern interfacial kinetics and CO2 release onset in EMAR anodes?
mechanism_or_method: Time-resolved in situ FTIR, UV-vis, voltammetry and DEMS with molecular dynamics showing Cl- promotes Cu ion release and CO2 desorption.
limitation: Single-cell lab electrochemistry; copper-amine system only.

object: oxide film regeneration on 70/30 copper-nickel alloy under magnetic field
problem: How does a magnetic field affect repair and corrosion resistance of scratched oxide films on Cu-Ni alloys in seawater?
mechanism_or_method: Scratch-regeneration experiments in 3.5 wt% NaCl with and without magnetic field, characterizing film structure, local pH and NiO enrichment.
limitation: Simulated scratches in lab solution; real flow, particle scouring and pipeline-scale field application untested.
decision_relevance: Suggests magnetic-field in-situ film repair for marine Cu-Ni pipelines.

object: dew point evaporative cooler with boiling suppression
problem: Can boiling be suppressed in confined water films to enable high-temperature evaporative cooling of hot air?
mechanism_or_method: Water film confined in superhydrophilic hierarchical nano/microstructured surfaces gives bubble-free interfacial steam generation, used in a dew-point cooler.
limitation: Lab prototype; durability, fouling and scale-up of nanostructured surfaces unaddressed.
decision_relevance: Enables evaluating evaporative cooling for hot-gas streams in power and engine systems.

object: hyperelastic omniadhesive polymer gels
problem: How can gels simultaneously achieve hyperelasticity and strong adhesion to diverse substrates?
mechanism_or_method: Partial curing yields networks with long dangling chains and identical-chemistry good solvent, screening interchain interactions and enabling adsorption to substrates.
limitation: Adhesion ~510 J/m2 shown on lab samples; long-term and in-service durability unclear.

object: superelastic high-entropy alloy
problem: How can Hookean and non-Hookean superelasticity be tuned continuously within one alloy system?
mechanism_or_method: Composition tuning produces a hidden strain order from frustrated crystallization of two phases, revealed by atomic-scale strain mapping and first-principles calculations.
limitation: Specific alloy family; fatigue and cyclic stability of ~8% recoverable strain not stated.

object: radiative cooling roofs for grain storage
problem: How effective is radiative cooling on granary roofs in reducing grain temperature and energy use across global climates?
mechanism_or_method: Building-energy and heat-transfer simulation of radiative cooling material on granary roofs across ten climates with economic and carbon analysis.
limitation: Simulation-based; real granary validation and material aging effects not evident from abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides whether to retrofit granary roofs with radiative cooling by climate and payback.

object: amorphous energetic material DATNBI
problem: Can a stable amorphous phase of a rigid explosive molecule be obtained without additives while improving energy release?
mechanism_or_method: Melt quenching of DATNBI yields glass stabilized by non-planar framework and 3D hydrogen-bond network, reducing hotspot formation.
limitation: Glass transition only ~60 C and stability shown for 24 hours; limited thermal envelope.

object: high-entropy CoOOH oxygen evolution catalysts
problem: How to identify active sites and screen high-entropy OER catalysts with low overpotential?
mechanism_or_method: Attention-enhanced multiobjective model predicts overpotential and doping energy over 17,500 candidates, followed by automated synthesis validation.
limitation: Model trained on computed data; only one catalyst experimentally validated in the abstract.

object: test case selection for automated driving system safety validation
problem: How to choose a limited set of test cases that represent naturalistic driving and cover high-risk corner cases?
mechanism_or_method: Kernel Test Case Sampling selects cases from a large naturalistic driving study balancing representativeness and coverage, enabling accident-rate estimation.
limitation: Depends on the naturalistic dataset coverage; actual ADS testing outcomes not shown in abstract.
decision_relevance: Defines which scenarios regulators and developers use to validate automated driving safety.

object: graphene-inspired porous polymer network PPN-20
problem: Can an ultramicroporous polymer network separate ethane from ethylene and purify methane in one step?
mechanism_or_method: Precisely engineered pore sizes enable preferential C-H...pi interactions with C2H6 and C3H8; evaluated by adsorption, IAST and breakthrough.
limitation: C2H6/C2H4 selectivity only 2.2; IAST-based selectivities rather than measured mixtures for most pairs.

object: additively manufactured heat-resistant aluminum alloy
problem: How to make strong, ductile Al alloys retaining strength and creep resistance at 300-400 C without post-treatment?
mechanism_or_method: Laser powder bed fusion embeds ~14 vol% heat-resistant multicomponent intermetallic nanophases at cell boundaries, with solid-state amorphization toughening.
limitation: 400 C strength only 114 MPa; long-term creep and fatigue under service conditions not reported.
decision_relevance: Enables considering printed Al parts for 300-400 C components replacing heavier alloys.

object: poly(propylene glycol)-based vitrimers
problem: How do bond exchange kinetics relate to segmental dynamics in controlling network rearrangement in vitrimers?
mechanism_or_method: Rheological and dynamic measurements of model vitrimers compare bond rearrangement time with segmental relaxation time across temperatures.
limitation: Simple additive timescale description fails quantitatively; limited to model PPG vitrimers.

object: hygroscopic wood composite for atmospheric water harvesting
problem: How to speed sorption and sustain desorption of atmospheric water harvesters under intermittent solar input?
mechanism_or_method: LiCl-embedded aligned-channel wood sponge combined with phase-change-material photothermal hydrogel storing heat for continuous desorption.
limitation: Daily yield only 0.96-1.72 L per kg sorbent; short outdoor tests; LiCl leakage and durability unclear.

object: solar interfacial evaporator with multiphase flow management
problem: How to achieve ultrahigh evaporation efficiency with salt resistance by coordinating water, vapor, salt and heat transport?
mechanism_or_method: Bimodal PVA-PVP hydrogel, perforated Juncus effusus stems and lambda-Ti3O5 absorber integrated under a multiphase-flow framework.
limitation: Apparent efficiency 278% counts environmental heat; long-term fouling and outdoor durability not shown.

object: light-controlled ultrasonic phased array
problem: How to drive large high-intensity ultrasound arrays with one amplifier while controlling per-element phase?
mechanism_or_method: Light-responsive analog phase shifters set element phase continuously over plus or minus pi by light intensity, enabling multifocal beams and vortices.
limitation: Small demonstration arrays; high-intensity operation and large-array scaling not yet shown.

object: CO2-responsive nanophase-separated elastomers
problem: How to reversibly switch solid-state polymers from soft elastomers to rigid fluorescent plastics using CO2?
mechanism_or_method: Nanophase-separated PEI (CO2-vitrifiable) and PDMS (CO2-permeable) elastomers stiffen from ~1 MPa to >2 GPa on CO2 exposure.
limitation: Response speed, cycling durability and humidity effects not detailed in abstract.

object: self-trapped beams in photoresponsive hydrogel
problem: Can a soft material perform logic computation internally via light-induced interactions?
mechanism_or_method: Three self-trapped beams compete through hydrogel contraction and refractive index change; geometry-dependent inhibition implements NAND gates, chained up to twelve.
limitation: Slow hydrogel response and optical bench setup; scaling to complex circuits unproven.

object: phosphorescent epoxy network in rubbery state
problem: Can cross-linked polymer networks show sensitive reversible mechanical-compression phosphorescence at high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Phosphorescent dye doped into epoxy resin with tuned free volume; compression at low stress triggers phosphorescence that spontaneously recovers.
limitation: 12 cycles only; abstract is truncated and practical sensing demonstrations are limited.

object: unidirectional surface acoustic wave transducers on LiTaO3/SiC
problem: Can symmetric transducers emit different SAW modes in opposite directions to build a minimal on-chip frequency splitter?
mechanism_or_method: Ion-sliced 42Y LiTaO3 bonded on 4H-SiC enables double-mode natural unidirectional transducer emitting SH-SAW and leaky SAW oppositely.
limitation: Transmission ratio of only >15 dB; requires heterogeneous wafer bonding fabrication.

object: spent layered oxide cathodes upcycled to Li-rich materials
problem: How to upgrade degraded cathodes into higher-capacity Li-rich oxides rather than restoring them to original state?
mechanism_or_method: Vacancy defects in degraded materials give Li diffusion paths converting R-3m layered phase to C2/m with Li2TMO3 domains, activating anion redox.
limitation: Cycling shown for 300 cycles; Li-rich oxide voltage fade and long-term safety not covered.

object: L12-structured multi-element symbiotic intermetallic alloy
problem: How to overcome the poor fatigue endurance of ordered intermetallic alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-element sublattice occupation raises antiphase boundary energy and builds disordered interfacial nanolayers that enable faulting and twinning, shifting cracking to transgranular.
limitation: Room-temperature fatigue of small specimens; high-temperature and variable-load fatigue not shown.
decision_relevance: Supports considering intermetallics for fatigue-loaded aerospace and nuclear parts.

object: origami-based mechanical programmable gate array
problem: How to build general-purpose mechanical computing that is both programmable and scalable?
mechanism_or_method: Bistable origami switch logic units from Quine-McCluskey mapping, with conductive networks and a magnetically guided robotic activation mechanism.
limitation: Bench-scale prototype with robotic addressing; speed and large-array scaling unproven.

object: 4D printed stiff and tough multimaterial composites
problem: How to combine high stiffness and toughness in shape-morphing 4D printed structures?
mechanism_or_method: Multimaterial printing of stiff synthetic muscle fibers surrounded by soft stretchable adhesive fascia, inspired by skeletal muscle.
limitation: Lab-scale printed demonstrators; long-term fatigue and actuation cycling not described.

object: microfluidic fluid thermal conductivity sensor
problem: How to measure fluid thermal conductivity rapidly and accurately with microliter samples?
mechanism_or_method: Comparing thermally driven voltage variations across resistive heaters in symmetric microchannels against an on-chip reference, avoiding direct temperature and heat flux sensing.
limitation: Expanded uncertainty about 8.3%; needs fabricated chip and reference material.
decision_relevance: Speeds screening of heat transfer fluids for thermal system design.

object: Cu-Zn-Al elastocaloric shape memory alloy single crystal
problem: How to get low driving force, low hysteresis and stable elastocaloric refrigeration in shape memory alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Composition modulation of Cu-18Zn-8Al-0.3V-0.3Si creates ordered domains and distortion regions forming non-twinned martensite.
limitation: Single crystals tested for 800 cycles only; polycrystal manufacturability and device-level performance unclear.
decision_relevance: Informs material choice for solid-state elastocaloric refrigeration devices.

object: porous organic cage mixed matrix membranes
problem: How to achieve efficient enantioseparation at high feed concentration with defect-free mixed matrix membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Soluble chiral porous organic cages as fillers give interface-defect-free membranes with enantioselective microporous chiral environment.
limitation: Flux is low (about 2.9e-3 mol m-2 h-1) and one racemate tested.

object: soft 3D electromagnetic morphable structures
problem: How to make 3D soft structures that reshape rapidly and remain locally programmable after assembly?
mechanism_or_method: Compressive buckling of liquid metal microfluidics with Lorentz force actuation, guided by multiphysics modeling.
limitation: Requires magnetic field and fabricated microfluidic devices; application demonstrations are early-stage.

object: slow earthquake analog granular shear experiments
problem: What physical origin gives slow earthquakes their moment release and size distribution statistics?
mechanism_or_method: Stick-slip experiments on low-friction soft hydrogel particle layer floating on lubricating fluid reproduce slow earthquake statistics via localization and porosity-pressure competition.
limitation: Analog laboratory system; direct mapping to hydrothermal fault conditions is inferred.

object: dissolutive wetting in metallic systems
problem: Which thermodynamic parameters control dissolutive wetting behaviors of liquid metals on solid metal substrates?
mechanism_or_method: Wetting experiments on nine metal systems with DFT calculations identify liquid solubility and solidification composition range as controlling parameters.
limitation: Nine systems only; practical process conditions such as welding flux and geometry not examined.
decision_relevance: Guides selection of filler and substrate pairs for brazing, coating and infiltration.

object: shape-evolving microfiber rails for droplet transport
problem: How to transport droplets directionally on non-gradient surfaces with independent control of distance and speed?
mechanism_or_method: Microfiber rails deform in response to droplet contact, generating cascading dynamic gradients in a domino-like mechanism.
limitation: Demonstrated at lab scale with specific fiber and liquid combinations.

object: topological defects of vibrational eigenmodes in 3D glass
problem: What is the geometry of eigenmode topological defects in glasses and how do they shape plastic events?
mechanism_or_method: Numerical simulation of a model 3D glass analyzing low-frequency eigenmode defects and quasi-static shear plastic rearrangements.
limitation: Single prototypical model glass in simulation; no experimental validation.

object: prestressed curved elastic rod metamaterials
problem: How to build reconfigurable mechanical systems with many stable states and tunable static and dynamic properties?
mechanism_or_method: Elastic rod origami using prestressed naturally curved rods under clamped boundaries; multirod assemblies give multistable configurations with tunable stiffness and wave behavior.
limitation: Lab prototypes; actuation and reconfiguration of large assemblies not detailed.

object: graded phononic metamaterials with microfabricated beam lattices
problem: How to scale design and fabrication of phononic metamaterials to hundreds of thousands of unit cells?
mechanism_or_method: Ray-tracing-based inverse design of graded beam lattices, fabricated by photolithography and etching of silicon wafers, verified by laser interferometry.
limitation: Silicon microscale films with pulsed-laser excitation; macro-scale applicability unclear.

object: radiation-resistant austenitic stainless steel with nanocrystalline surface
problem: Can radiation-induced martensitic transformation be turned from detrimental into beneficial for radiation resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Surface nano-crystallized 304NG steel with high stacking fault, twin-boundary and low-angle boundary density triggers adaptive martensitic transformation under irradiation.
limitation: Ion-irradiation style testing of thin surface layers; bulk component and neutron irradiation performance not shown.
decision_relevance: Suggests surface treatment route for nuclear-grade steels under irradiation.

object: beta-NiAl intermetallic surface phase separation
problem: What mechanism drives surface phase separation in intermetallics at high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ electron microscopy, synchrotron X-ray absorption and first-principles show vacancy formation asymmetry drives Ni segregation forming surface gamma-prime Ni3Al.
limitation: Single archetypal alloy; synchrotron and in-situ microscopy access required.
decision_relevance: Refines thermal stability limits when selecting intermetallics for high-temperature service.

object: stiffening chiral liquid crystal elastomer photonic films
problem: How to get room-temperature self-stiffening shape-color integrated memory in photonic elastomers?
mechanism_or_method: Long linear side chains in chiral LCE cause microphase separation of ordered phases from chiral nematic phase, raising modulus by 1854% within 48 hours.
limitation: Stiffening takes 48 hours; restoration requires heating.

object: high-silica zeolite molecular-sieving membranes
problem: How to rapidly synthesize continuous slow-crystallizing zeolite membranes with fewer intergranular defects?
mechanism_or_method: Supersaturated nucleus-rich active gel with enhanced crystallization rate gives uniform nucleus loading and continuous membranes in hours.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; large-area and long-term operating stability not detailed.

object: evaporation-driven hydrovoltaic device with silicon nanopillars
problem: Which coupled heat and light-driven interfacial charge processes dominate hydrovoltaic electricity generation?
mechanism_or_method: Intermediate ion-conducting layer decouples interfaces in a silicon-dielectric nanopillar device; equivalent-circuit model with transfer capacitance explains photocharging and thermal equilibria.
limitation: Low power density of 0.25 W/m2 and lab-scale devices.

object: thin-film composite reverse osmosis membranes at high temperature
problem: Why do TFC RO membranes fail above 60 C and can cross-linked supports prevent it?
mechanism_or_method: Controlled experiments, molecular dynamics and micromechanical modeling show polysulfone pore expansion ruptures polyamide; thin-film cross-linked TFX membranes resist deformation up to 80 C.
limitation: Tested only to 80 C in lab coupons; long-term fouling and pressure cycling not reported.
decision_relevance: Informs whether RO membranes can treat hot industrial streams without cooling.

object: shape memory alloy fiber textile actuators
problem: How to design thin compliant energy-dense fabric actuators with large contraction for wearable assistance?
mechanism_or_method: SMA fibers interlaced in periodic X-Crossing geometry with a variable-stiffness mechanics model predicting force-contraction relations and upper bound.
limitation: Thermal actuation is slow and energy hungry; on-body durability not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides SMA textile geometry choice for wearable lifting and compression devices.

object: digital composites with liquid metal voxels
problem: How to reprogram solid-liquid phase architecture of composites at voxel resolution after fabrication?
mechanism_or_method: Elastomeric voxels containing liquid metal composites switch electrically between nonvolatile solid and liquid states, modeled with coupled constitutive models.
limitation: Switching takes seconds and needs embedded electrodes; scalability of voxel addressing unclear.

object: acoustic shape-morphing microbubble micromachines
problem: How to build microrobots that change shape within milliseconds at small scale?
mechanism_or_method: Two microbubbles joined by a microhinge deform through acoustic-excitation interaction forces; design principles enable forward and inverse design.
limitation: Proof-of-concept microstructures in controlled acoustic fields; in vivo use not shown.

object: nonporous hydrophobic alkylated monoethanolamine crystals
problem: Can nonporous organic crystals capture CO2 rapidly through solid-to-solid phase transition with low regeneration energy?
mechanism_or_method: Chain-melting phase transition on CO2 uptake forms anhydrous ammonium carbamate, confirmed by in situ XRPD, solid-state NMR and Raman.
limitation: Lab-scale powders; long-term cycling and real flue gas contaminants not described.

object: anemone-like light-driven hydrogel robot
problem: How to integrate infrared sensing with hydrogel robot bodies for directional motion and detection?
mechanism_or_method: BP/WS2 moire superlattice in PNIPAM hydrogel gives photothermal actuation of tentacles and photovoltaic current signals on electrode contact.
limitation: Lab prototype; response speed and operation outside controlled illumination not shown.

object: Cyclen/Matrimid mixed-matrix membranes for helium extraction
problem: How to reach He/CH4 selectivity above 1000 in Matrimid membranes for helium recovery from natural gas?
mechanism_or_method: Cyclen macrocycle filler forms hydrogen bonds with Matrimid, densifying chain packing and tuning interchain gaps, supported by molecular dynamics.
limitation: Pure-gas lab tests; physical aging tracked only 110 days; low permeability.

object: bioinspired polymer composites with stress-adaptive interface
problem: How to resolve the strength, toughness and impact resistance trade-off in polymer composites?
mechanism_or_method: Trabecular interlock architecture with thermodynamically driven stress-adaptive interface, optimized via Pareto Set Learning and active learning.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; fatigue, environmental aging and manufacturing scale-up not covered.
decision_relevance: Guides composite formulation choice for lightweight aerospace and protection structures.

object: MOF-801 pervaporation membranes with controlled missing linkers
problem: How does regulating missing linkers improve water flux and salt rejection for hypersaline water pervaporation?
mechanism_or_method: Fumarate-to-formic-acid ratio tunes missing linkers in nano-seeded ceramic-supported MOF-801, increasing hydrophilicity and pore window size.
limitation: Lab membranes; long-term stability duration and scale-up unspecified.

object: covalent adaptable networks with N-hydroxyphthalimide-urethane bonds
problem: How to keep thermomechanical stability in reprocessable networks while retaining dynamic behavior?
mechanism_or_method: Highly active dynamic NUB bonds at only 5 mol% content give catalyst-free association and partial dissociation at 120 C in poly(NHPI-urethane) networks.
limitation: Lab-synthesized polymers; creep, long-term aging and scaled processing not discussed.

object: electroactive dielectric elastomer with polar additives
problem: How to give dielectric elastomers active control of electroadhesion and electrowetting alongside actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Polar small-molecule additives create an electroactive interface, raising electroadhesion 488-fold and giving strong electrowetting-on-dielectric response.
limitation: Requires high field of 14 MV/m; durability and humidity effects not described.

object: densified hybrid cellulose paper
problem: How to make strong, tough, energy-efficient cellulose paper to replace petrochemical plastics?
mechanism_or_method: Bacterial cellulose microgels and nanofibers fill pulp fiber voids and form densely bonded interfaces via capillary-driven assembly during dehydration.
limitation: Lab-scale sheets; bacterial cellulose supply cost and industrial papermaking scale-up not shown.
